newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish bonds end lower but outperform Bunds.
newsitem.headline: Spanish bonds end lower but outperform Bunds.

text.p: Spain's debt market nudged lower to close down on Tuesday, although outperforming Bunds, as dealers took profits after a landmark deal on budget stability was concluded in Amsterdam.
Dealers in Madrid said they were sceptical about the pact and expected a treacherous path toward EMU.
"The more we see how much the euro is tied to politicians the more the story seems a farce," said Jose Ramon Arechederra at ABN Amro in Madrid.
"I do not understand why France made the fuss it did after the election," he added.
